lot_53_dispute_ticket.name: LOT 53 DISPUTE TICKET
lot_53_dispute_ticket.description: A RED CARBON-COPY TICKET FOR LOT 53. REASON: LACK OF PRIVACY — CUSTOMER PRESENT. THE CLERK HAS STAMPED IT HOLD FOR INSPECTION. IT ENTITLES YOU TO INSPECT THE DISPUTED MERCHANDISE BEFORE IT LEAVES THE HOTEL, BUT IT DOES NOT CANCEL THE SALE.

description.text: A SMALL SILVER WEDDING BAND FREED FROM LOT 31'S UPHOLSTERY. A SHORT PALE BLUE RIBBON STILL CLINGS TO IT. TINY LETTERS ARE ENGRAVED INSIDE, TOO SMALL TO READ AT A GLANCE.

YOU TURN THE SILVER BAND BETWEEN YOUR FINGERS. A SMALL STRAND OF BLUE RIBBON HANGS FROM IT.

INSIDE, BENEATH A TINY MAKER'S MARK, YOU CAN FINALLY MAKE OUT THE ENGRAVING:

AS IS, WHERE IS.

THE STANDARD TERMS OF AN AUCTION.

AS WEDDING PROMISES GO, YOU'VE HEARD WORSE.
